# Clean up PVM adapter

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Since now we deploy the entire `@typeberry/lib` to NPM, we don't need to re-export everything in the pvm-debugger package. Re-exports look a bit shitty on the API documentation page.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Breaking Changes**
  * Simplified the public API surface by consolidating exports from the debugger adapter package.
  * Only the DebuggerAdapter (exported as Pvm) is now publicly available.
  * Previously re-exported modules and utilities are no longer accessible from this package's public interface.
  * Consumers may need to import dependencies directly from their original sources.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The pull request removes a comprehensive set of re-exported modules and named exports from the pvm-debugger-adapter public API surface, retaining only the DebuggerAdapter export aliased as Pvm. This involves removing re-exports from multiple dependencies (block, bytes, hash, jam-host-calls, numbers, pvm-host-calls, pvm-program, pvm-spi-decoder, and utility modules) and corresponding cleanup of transitive dependencies from package.json. The three core dependencies (`@typeberry/pvm-interface`, `@typeberry/pvm-interpreter`, and `@typeberry/utils`) are retained.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

- Verify that removed re-exports were not part of the public contract or used by consumers
- Confirm that internal usage within the package doesn't rely on the removed re-exports
- Validate that all transitive dependencies removed from package.json correspond to the removed exports and are not needed elsewhere

- [`#375`](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/375): Both PRs modify the public exports in packages/core/pvm-debugger-adapter/index.ts, restructuring which symbols are re-exported
- [`#442`](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/442): Related through changes to the exports surface of packages/core/pvm-debugger-adapter/index.ts
